title: Epigenomic and transcriptomic landscaping unraveled candidate repositioned therapeutics for non-functioning pituitary neuroendocrine tumors.
authors: Aydin, B; Beklen, H; Arga, K Y; Bayrakli, F; Turanli, B
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合表观基因组和转录组数据构建PPI网络并基于分子对接进行药物重定位，虽涉及蛋白互作和对接，但核心是肿瘤药物筛选而非TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Non-functioning pituitary neuroendocrine tumors are challengingly diagnosed tumors in the clinic. Transsphenoidal surgery remains the first-line treatment. Despite the development of state-of-the-art techniques, no drug therapy is currently approved for the treatment. There are also no randomized controlled trials comparing therapeutic strategies or drug therapy for the management after surgery. Therefore, novel therapeutic interventions for the therapeutically challenging NF-PitNETs are urgently needed. METHODS: We integrated epigenome and transcriptome data (both coding and non-coding) that elucidate disease-specific signatures, in addition to biological and pharmacological data, to utilize rational pathway and drug prioritization in NF-PitNETs. We constructed an epigenome- and transcriptome-based PPI network and proposed hub genes. The signature-based drug repositioning based on the integration of multi-omics data was performed. RESULTS: The construction of a disease-specific network based on three different biological levels revealed DCC, DLG5, ETS2, FOXO1, HBP1, HMGA2, PCGF3, PSME4, RBPMS, RREB1, SMAD1, SOCS1, SOX2, YAP1, ZFHX3 as hub proteins. Signature-based drug repositioning using hub proteins yielded repositioned drug candidates that were confirmed in silico via molecular docking. As a result of molecular docking simulations, palbociclib, linifanib, trametinib, eplerenone, niguldipine, and zuclopenthixol showed higher binding affinities with hub genes compared to their inhibitors and were proposed as potential repositioned therapeutics for the management of NF-PitNETs. CONCLUSION: The proposed systems' biomedicine-oriented multi-omics data integration for drug repurposing to provide promising results for the construction of effective clinical therapeutics. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study reporting epigenome- and transcriptome-based drug repositioning for NF-PitNETs using in silico confirmations.
abstract_zh: 目的：无功能性垂体神经内分泌肿瘤（NF-PitNETs）是临床上诊断具有挑战性的肿瘤。经蝶手术仍是首选治疗方法。尽管先进技术不断发展，但目前尚无药物疗法获批用于治疗。此外，也没有随机对照试验比较术后管理中的治疗策略或药物疗法。因此，迫切需要针对治疗困难的NF-PitNETs的新型治疗干预措施。方法：我们整合了表观基因组和转录组数据（包括编码和非编码），以阐明疾病特异性特征，并结合生物学和药理学数据，在NF-PitNETs中进行合理的通路和药物优先排序。我们构建了基于表观基因组和转录组的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，并提出了核心基因。基于多组学数据整合的特征性药物重定位得以实施。结果：基于三个不同生物学水平构建的疾病特异性网络揭示了DCC、DLG5、ETS2、FOXO1、HBP1、HMGA2、PCGF3、PSME4、RBPMS、RREB1、SMAD1、SOCS1、SOX2、YAP1、ZFHX3为核心蛋白。使用核心蛋白进行的基于特征的药物重定位产生了重定位候选药物，并通过分子对接在计算机模拟中进行了验证。分子对接模拟结果显示，palbociclib、linifanib、trametinib、eplerenone、niguldipine和zuclopenthixol与核心基因的结合亲和力高于其抑制剂，并被提议作为NF-PitNETs管理的潜在重定位治疗药物。结论：所提出的系统生物医学导向的多组学数据整合用于药物再利用，为构建有效临床治疗提供了有前景的结果。据我们所知，这是首次报道基于表观基因组和转录组并使用计算机模拟验证的NF-PitNETs药物重定位研究。
